informal_restatement.author: Formalia 维护者（据 formal-conjectures 文档注释翻译）
informal_restatement.text: 每个正整数都能写成至多 5 个四面体数之和。
informal_restatement.text_en:
Pollock's (tetrahedral numbers) conjecture:
every integer is the sum of at most $5$ tetrahedral numbers.
